{{Quote|Bombers, keep that tight formation. Fighters, protect the bombers. It's not everyday we get a shot at a dreadnought, so let's make this count.|Tallissan Lintra during the evacuation of D'Qar|audio=MakeThisCount.flac|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
'''Tallissan Lintra''', nicknamed "'''Tallie'''," was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[pilot]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] and [[squadron commander]] in the [[Resistance]]'s [[Resistance navy|naval]] branch during the [[New Republic Era]]. Before joining the Resistance, Lintra lived on a [[Tallissan Lintra's farm|farm]] with her [[parent]]s on the [[planet]] [[Pippip 3]] where she learned how to fly using her [[Tallissan Lintra's father|father's]] old [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]. She also had a sister named [[Kallie Lintra]] that also joined the Resistance. Some [[time]] after joining the Resistance, Lintra participated in a series of [[Missions against pirates in the Cassander sector|missions]] against a [[Sheh Soahi's pirates|group]] of [[pirate]]s in the [[Cassander sector]]. By the time of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]], Lintra was known as one of the Resistance's most capable [[Resistance pilot|pilots]]. She piloted a [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]] and served as [[Blue Leader]] during the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation of D'Qar]] until her [[Death|demise]] aboard the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] at the hands of a pair of [[missile]]s [[Battle of Oetchi|fired]] by [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren's]] [[Kylo Ren's TIE silencer|TIE silencer]].

==Biography==
===Joining the Resistance===
Tallissan Lintra was [[Reproduction|born]]<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> in [[12 ABY]]<ref name="Birth note" /> long after the [[Imperial Era|dark days]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> She had a sister named [[Kallie Lintra]],<ref name="TROS JN" /> and during her early life Tallissan Lintra and her [[parent]]s lived on a [[Tallissan Lintra's farm|farm]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> on the [[planet]]<ref name="SWCT Masterworks">{{Topps|set=2019 Topps Star Wars Masterwork|cardname=#86: Tallissan 'Tallie' Lintra|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/207015/cid/13853991/2019-Topps-Star-Wars-Masterwork-59-Tallie-Lintra|nobackup=1}}</ref> [[Pippip 3]],<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> where she learned how to fly using her [[Tallissan Lintra's father|father's]] crop duster [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|RZ-1 A-wing]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> During her days on Pippip 3, she developed a strong sense of protecting the peace that the [[New Republic]] had brought to [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Build X-Wing 35">{{BuildXWingCite|35|Starfighter Aces}}</ref>

In [[28 ABY]],<ref name="Date Resistance">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] created the [[Resistance]] six [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, using simple math it can be concluded that the creation of the Resistance must have taken place in [[28 ABY]].</ref> [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] created the [[Resistance]], a small paramilitary force created to oppose the [[First Order]], the successor state of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> By [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note" /> Lintra joined the Resistance, after she became frustrated with the way the New Republic was handling the rise of the First Order. She was hoping to help the next generation of [[Youngling|children]] be free,<ref name="Build X-Wing 35" /> and to make history alongside it.<ref name="TSWB">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> Lintra became a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Resistance navy]] and one of their most capable [[Resistance pilot|pilots]], impressing [[Poe Dameron]] with her piloting skills.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />

===Helping Dekkr===
{{Quote|This is Lt. Tallissan Lintra of the Resistance. Is there anyone aboard? I repeat–|Lintra trying to contact any survivors aboard the ship before encountering Staaysha Dekkr|<ref name="Adventures 26">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=26|story=Tales from Wild Space: Alone in the Dark}}</ref>}}
[[File:TallieLintraGasCloud-SWAdventures26.png|thumb|left|250px|Lintra and the Resistance forces near the gas cloud received a distress signal that came from inside the cloud.]]
At some point after joining the Resistance, Lintra was in charge of a [[Teacher|training]] session which [[Stomeroni Starck]] and three other Resistance pilots were taking part. Training near an ionized [[Unidentified gas cloud|gas cloud]], Starck reported to Lintra that cloud was causing [[sensor]] interference and recommend aborting the flight. Agreeing with the recommendation, Lintra decided that training without sensors was not what she had in mind and notified the<ref name="Adventures 26" /> [[Free Virgillia-class Bunkerbuster|''Free Virgillia''-class Bunkerbuster]]<ref name="TLJICS">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> ''[[Ninka]]'' that they would return to the [[Starship|ship]]. Using her [[callsign]] of [[Blue Leader]] she informed the ''Ninka'' that there was no point on continuing the training session without sensors.<ref name="Adventures 26" />

While she was returning to the ship a [[distress signal]] alerted the Resistance forces near the area. After getting the report that the signal was coming from inside the cloud, Lintra returned and flew into the cloud to look after the stranded ship. While inside the cloud [[Tallissan Lintra's RZ-2 A-wing interceptor|her]] [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]] lost power for all communications, sensors and [[Navigation computer|navicomputer]] systems, but she was still able to locate the [[Staaysha Dekkr's starship|stranded ship]].<ref name="Adventures 26" />

[[File:TallieLintraDekkr-SWAdventures26.png|thumb|right|200px|Lintra helped Staaysha Dekkr to get out of the gas cloud.]]
To locate any survivors, Lintra boarded the ship and search for anyone inside. While searching she noted that the starship systems were working fine and that the ship lights were on manual lockdown, noting that the internal comms were working Lintra identified herself and asked if there was anyone aboard the ship. While she was repeating her message, a [[Duros]] named [[Staaysha Dekkr]] approached Lintra at [[blaster]] point thinking she was a [[pirate]] and tried to put her on the [[brig]]. Lintra confused about the situation explained that she was trying to help after receiving the ship's beacon. Dekkr explained that while trying to impress the boss by getting an early docking slot at [[Klytus V Station]], the Duros attempted to plot a shortcut through the [[nebula]], but the sensors went down and the ship got lost inside it.<ref name="Adventures 26" />

Lintra looked into the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] to see if there was anything they could do. Trying to come up with an idea, Lintra asked if the nebula was mapped to which Dekkr answered that it was since it was navigation hazard. While observing the Nebula [[Star map|map]] Lintra noted that her [[A-wing starfighter]] ion exhaust had left a trail, Lintra then restarted the navicomputer so they ship could lock the exhaust signature and follow it. After rebooting the navicomputer, Starck and the rest of the [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]s reached the location of the Dekkr's starship and tried to contact the ship, but Lintra informed Starck that she was onboard and that she was helping Dekkr. After helping Dekkr to return to safety, Lintra accompanied Dekkr aboard the ''Ninka'' where they met [[Amilyn Holdo]]. Inside the ship Dekkr expressed to be thankful for the Resistance help and shared the map for the gas cloud, which would be uploaded to the Resistance [[databank]]s.<ref name="Adventures 26" />

===Cassander sector campaign===
{{Quote|Tallie's A-wings were swooping in to pound our attackers.|Paige Tico writing about Tallie's service during the battle of Mamkoda|<ref name="Bomber Command" />}}
[[File:Ninka_DB.png|thumb|left|250px|Lintra's A-wing squadron was stationed on the ''Ninka'' during their campaign in the Cassander sector.]]
In 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],<ref name="Date Note Cassander">According to ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', the [[missions against pirates in the Cassander sector]] take place in [[34 ABY]].</ref> the Resistance learned that [[Sheh Soahi's pirates|pirates]] armed by the First Order had started to raid the [[star system]]s in the [[Cassander sector]]. In response to the threat of the [[sector]] being taken by the First Order, the Resistance [[Missions against pirates in the Cassander sector|sent]] Lintra and [[Tallie Torchers|her]] A-wing [[squadron]] as well as [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|bombers]] from [[Cobalt Squadron|Cobalt]] and [[Crimson Squadron]] to the sector. The Resistance's [[Battle of Mamkoda|first target]] in the sector was to destroy a pirate controlled [[Mamkoda spaceport|spaceport]] on [[Mamkoda]], Lintra and her squadron were assigned to protect the [[bomber]]s while they made their attack run on the [[spaceport]]. During the battle, Lintra and her squadron encountered heavy resistance from the pirates, but the Resistance bombers were able to destroy their target.<ref name="Bomber Command" />

Three [[Standard day|days]] after the mission on Mamkoda, Lintra and the Resistance forces undertook a [[Mission to Caraxl|relief mission]] to [[Caraxl]]. While the bombers started to deliver the supplies, Lintra reported to the bombers that First Order [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] were on an intercept course to their position. As their orders were to avoid confrontation with First Order vessels, the mission was aborted and they headed back to the ''Ninka''. After returning they learned that the [[Sheh Soahi pirate base|pirates' base]] was located on [[Sheh Soahi]], with the information Resistance forces were able to [[Battle of Sheh Soahi|destroy]] the base and get proof of the First Order alliance with the pirates.<ref name="Bomber Command" />

===Evacuation of D'Qar===
{{Quote|Gunners, look alive!|Tallissan Lintra giving orders to the Resistance squadrons|audio=GunnersLookAlive.flac|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
[[File:Tallie-PoeDameron28.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tallissan Lintra was present when General Organa ordered the evacuation of D'Qar.]]
Following the [[Battle of Starkiller Base|destruction]] of [[Starkiller Base]],<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref> ships from the Resistance fleet arrived at [[D'Qar]] with new complements of [[starfighter]]s and joined the remaining forces stationed on the planet to reinforce the [[Resistance base]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> After the Resistance learned that the First Order was regrouping, Lintra was present on a briefing where General Organa ordered to [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuate]] the planet, shocked by the decision, Lintra discussed with [[Suralinda Javos]] about it. During the briefing Dameron designed a semi-improvised plan to protect the evacuation ships, Lintra and the A-wings were assigned as the primary defense for the fleet.<ref name="Poe Dameron 28">[[Poe Dameron 28|''Poe Dameron'' 28]]</ref> Dameron also devised a plan to destroy a<ref name="TLJ Junior Novel" /> [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator'' IV-class Siege Dreadnought]]<ref name="TLJICS" /> after receiving the schematics from [[Inferno Squad (Resistance)|Inferno Squad]].<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref> As part of the plan [[squadron commander]] Lintra, piloting an A-wing starfighter<ref name="TLJ novel">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]''</ref> and assuming the leadership of [[Blue Squadron (Resistance)|Blue Squadron]],<ref name="Episode VIII" /> was assigned with the vital task of commanding the [[Resistance Starfighter Corps|Resistance starfighter forces]] and escort the bombers to the [[dreadnought]].<ref name="Build X-Wing 35" />

[[File:TallissanLintraEvacuation.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tallissan Lintra during the evacuation of D'Qar.]]
After the [[First Order Navy|First Order fleet]] arrived at D'Qar, Lintra and the fighters started their approach to the dreadnought after [[Commander]] Dameron had destroyed all the [[turbolaser]]s<ref name="Episode VIII" /> on the ''[[Fulminatrix]]''{{'s}}<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> surface. While they started to get closer to the dreadnought Lintra ordered the bombers to stay in formation and joked with her [[wingmate]] Stomeroni Starck to not get drawn into [[Starfighter combat|dogfights]]. During their approach [[Ben Teene]] spotted several [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] closing in formation, Lintra compared their formation to [[dire hound]]s loose among [[whellay]]s back home on Pippip 3.<ref name="TLJ novel" /> Once the TIE Fighters got close enough the Resistance fighters engaged in combat trying to clear a path for the bombers, after reaching the dreadnought Lintra ordered the [[bombardier]]s to start their dropping sequence on the ship, however the majority of the bombers were destroyed after one spiraling TIE [[cockpit]] detonated the [[proton bomb]]s in [[Crimson Smiter|one]] of the bombers. The only [[Cobalt Hammer|bomber]] left managed to drop its explosives destroying the dreadnought. As the dreadnought exploded Lintra and the surviving fighters returned to<ref name="Episode VIII" /> the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']]<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> and jumped into [[hyperspace]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

===Attack on the Resistance fleet===
{{Quote|That's practically an entire starfleet|Tallissan Lintra's reaction to the First Order fleet chasing them after D'Qar|<ref name="TLJ novel" />}}
[[File:TallieDeath.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tallissan Lintra moments before her death.]]
After fleeing from D'Qar, the Resistance [[fleet]] dropped out of hyperspace in the remote [[Oetchi system]].<ref name="TLJ Junior Novel" /> Unknown to the Resistance, the First Order had [[Hyperspace tracker|tracked]] them through hyperspace and began an [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] on their fleet.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> Lintra, whilst [[sleep]]ing, had a [[dream]] where she had to protect the Resistance bombers, but she couldn't see them but instead could only locate them by the screams of their pilots as they died. After being woken up by a [[klaxon]] in the ''Raddus'' ready room, Lintra and Starck confusingly looked at the [[holotank]] and realized that the First Order fleet had followed them. After putting on her [[boot]]s and her [[Flak vest|flight vest]] Lintra made her way to the [[hangar]].<ref name="TLJ novel" /> In the hangar Lintra and the rest of the fighters started up their ships in order to engage the First Order. Before they could take off, [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] fired a pair of [[missile]]s into the hangar<ref name="Episode VIII" /> from his [[Kylo Ren's TIE silencer|TIE silencer]],<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> killing Lintra and destroying the starfighters.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Actually, I once heard about a pilot who got lost in the dark…and who helped somone else face their fears.|Emil Graf referring to Tallissan Lintra|<ref name="Adventures 26" />}}
[[File:EmilGraf-SWAdventures26.png|thumb|left|220px|Emil Graf told Crater the story of Lintra's encounter with Dekkr.]]
Sometime after Lintra's encounter with Staaysha Dekkr the story became known to [[Emil Graf]], who shared the story with his [[BB-series astromech droid]] [[BB-00]] and with the [[monster droid]] [[CR-8R]] "Crater" aboard the ''[[Star Herald]]''. Graf told the story trying to help Crater overcome the fear of not being able to see anything after Graf replaced his [[photoreceptor]]s crystals. After sharing the entire story Crater started to feel batter and Graf took him to maintenance to so he could take an [[oil bath]].<ref name="Adventures 26" />

After the Resistance established their [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] of [[Ajan Kloss]], a squadron of RZ-2 A-wings was renamed to the "[[Tallie Torchers]]." Lintra's legacy was also honored by fellow A-wing pilot [[Merl Cobben]], who felt particularly indebted to Lintra since she saved his life in a previous skirmish.<ref name="TROS VD" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> the Resistance launched an [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] on the [[Final Order]], a [[fleet]] assembled by the [[Sith Eternal]] [[Religion|cult]], on the [[Unknown Regions]]' planet of [[Exegol]]. As part of the [[Exegol air team]], Tallissan Lintra's sister Kallie Lintra was killed after eight [[TIE/dg starfighter|Sith TIE fighters]] surrounded her A-wing. After her death, Poe Dameron took a deep breath and lamented that they had lost both Tallissan and Kallie Lintra during the war.<ref name="TROS JN" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Practice your dance moves later–we gotta fly.|Lintra joking with Starck|<ref name="TLJ novel" />}}
[[File:Heroic_XW2.png|thumb|right|250px|Tallie Lintra was considered one of the most capable pilots in the Resistance.]]
Tallissan Lintra was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who had light skin, [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, blonde [[hair]],<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> and she stood at a height of 1.73 [[meter]]s, or five [[Foot|feet]] and eight inches.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> Lintra's [[pilot]]ing skills were able to impress the Resistance ace pilot Poe Dameron and also made her one of the most capable pilots in the Resistance.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> She performed various roles in the Resistance, from leading relief missions to escorting starships.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

Her piloting skills came from flying an old RZ-1 A-wing as a cropduster on her homeworld of Pippip 3. With her expertise on the RZ-1, Lintra believed that flying the newer RZ-2 A-wing was like lacing her boots. Her leadership potential was noticed by the Resistance leadership who lead them to take the decision of give her the command of Blue Squadron during the evacuation of D'Qar.<ref name="A-Wing Incredibuilds">''[[Star Wars: A-wing Deluxe Book and 3D Wood Model]]''</ref> Lintra was also know to have the ability to swiftly adjust to unexpected developments<ref name="SWCT Masterworks" /> or changes in battles and use them to her advantage.<ref name="SWCT Masterworks 2018">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Masterwork|cardname=#87: Tallissan "Tallie" Lintra|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/173296/cid/11711833|nobackup=1}}</ref> During the evacuation of D'Qar, Lintra was considered a vital and essential part of the evacuation due to her ability to quickly assemble the fighter squadrons.<ref name="Topps 2020 Base">{{SWCT|set=2020 Base Series 2|cardname=Tallie Lintra}}</ref>

Lintra cared for her fellow pilots and she was afraid of not being able to help other pilots during combat. After the battle at D'Qar she started to had nightmares in which she couldn't see the other pilots, but she could only hear their screams as they were being killed. Lintra also had a good relationship with her wingmate Stomeroni Starck, she often joked with him,<ref name="TLJ novel" /> and tried to keep him in check.<ref name="Starck Databank">{{Databank|stomeroni-starck|Stomeroni Starck}}</ref>

Tallissan Lintra developed a strong sense of valuing and protecting the peace that the New Republic had brought to the galaxy. This sense helped her join the Resistance, after she became frustrated with the way the New Republic was handling the rise of the First Order.<ref name="Build X-Wing 35" />

==Equipment==
[[File:TallieHelmet-TLJVD.png|thumb|left|150px|Tallie Lintra's helmet]]
Lintra wore a standard green Resistance pilot [[Clothing|uniform]] that included a [[FreiTek Incorporated|FreiTek]] [[life support]] unit attached to her vest and a [[Guidenhauser]] [[Flight harness|ejection harness]]. She also wore a [[synthsilk]] [[scarf]] her father gifted her,<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> as a symbol of luck.<ref name="Build X-Wing 35" /> Lintra's red and white [[flight helmet]] had a yellow [[Rebel Alliance starbird]] and the letters "DA" in [[Aurebesh]], which stood for "Deadly Approach", a punch-line to a well-known pilots' joke.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> Lintra piloted a blue marked RZ-2 A-wing starfighter<ref name="Battlefront II" /> and carried a [[blaster pistol]] with her.<ref name="Tallie Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Fighters, protect the bombers—don't get drawn into dogfights. Let me hear you say copy that, Starck.''"<br />"''No fun, copy that.|Tallissan Lintra and Stomeroni Starck expanded dialogue in the novelization|<ref name="TLJ novel" />}}
[[File:HermioneCorfield.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Tallie Lintra was portrayed by Hermione Corfield.]]
Tallissan Lintra was portrayed by [[Wikipedia:English|English]] [[Wikipedia:Actor|actress]] [[Hermione Corfield]] in the [[2017]] ''Star Wars'' [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], which was written and directed by [[Rian Johnson]]. The character was credited as "A-Wing Pilot Tallie" in the film's end credits,<ref name="Episode VIII" /> but was later identified as "Tallissan Lintra" in the movie's [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary|''Visual Dictionary'']] and [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections|''Incredible Cross-Sections'']] reference books released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref> Corfield's involvement in the film was first announced by Rian Johnson on his [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] account on [[October 3]], 2017.<ref name="Hermione Corfield">{{Twitter|rianjohnson|status/915246636103639040|[[Rian Johnson]]|quote=The awesomely talented @MioneCorfield!|archivefile=File:TallieActressRevealed.jpg}}</ref>

Before Tallissan Lintra's appearance on the film, she was first mentioned in the [[2017]] activity book ''[[Star Wars: A-wing Deluxe Book and 3D Wood Model]]'', written by [[Michael Kogge]],<ref name="A-Wing Incredibuilds" /> and later made her first appearance in the 2017 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'', in its ''The Last Jedi'' season. The season introduced Tallie's RZ-2 A-Wing fighter as one of the playable starfighter hero units. Tallie's A-wing was added to the game two days before the film, on [[December 13]], 2017.<ref name="The Last Jedi Season">{{EA|url=games/starwars/battlefront/star-wars-battlefront-2/news/the-last-jedi-season-is-coming|text=Choose a Side: The Last Jedi Season Is Coming}}</ref>

Tallissan Lintra's dialogue is expanded on the movie's [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition|novelization]], during the opening sequence in which Lintra and the Resistance forces approach the First Order dreadnought, the Resistance forces are positioned farther than in the film and giving space to a brief interaction between Lintra and Stomeroni Starck.<ref name="TLJ novel" />

Tallissan Lintra is a playable character in the [[2020]] [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'', developed by [[Lucasfilm]] and [[JOYMAX]].<ref name="Starfighter Missions">''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]''</ref>
